pool.notFound: That discount code pool isn't in this workspace.

pool.slugFormat.message: Name it for templates with 1–32 lowercase letters, digits or _, such as {example}.

pool.slugTaken.message: Another pool is {slug} in templates already. Pick another name.
pool.slugTaken.note: slug: the name templates use, such as welcome15

pool.prefixFormat.message: A prefix is up to 12 capital letters, digits or -, such as {example}.

pool.lowAt: Warn below a number of codes from 0 to 1,000,000.

pool.applyURL.message: The apply address starts with https:// or http:// and holds {placeholder} where the code goes.

pool.storeMissing: Pick the store that creates the codes.
pool.storeUnknown: That store isn't connected to this workspace.

pool.storePlatform.message: {store} isn't a {platform} store. Pick its own source.
pool.storePlatform.note: store: the store's name; platform: Shopify or WooCommerce

pool.uploadStore: Uploaded codes don't come from a store. Leave the store out.
pool.kindMissing: Pick what the discount takes off: a percentage, a fixed amount or free shipping.
pool.amount: A fixed amount is more than 0.
pool.minimum: A minimum order is 0 or more.
pool.endsDays: A discount ends 1 to 365 days after it's created, or never (0).

pool.settingsLocked.message: The discount exists in {store} already, so it can't change. Create a new pool for another discount.

pool.archived.message: {name} is archived: it gives no new codes.

pool.archiveLive.message: {flows} {count, plural, one {sends} other {send}} codes from {name}. Archived, it gives none: their emails wait for codes, then are skipped after a day. Archive it anyway?
pool.archiveLive.note: flows: live automations' names, joined with and; count: how many; name: the pool's name

codes.none: Paste codes or upload a CSV: one code per line, 3–64 letters, digits, - or _.
codes.tooMany: Upload at most 100,000 codes at a time.

codes.storePool.message: {name} creates its codes in {store}. Use Create codes instead.
codes.storePool.note: name: the pool's name; store: the store's name

codes.uploadPool.message: {name} holds uploaded codes. Add codes to it instead.

codes.running.message: {name} is creating codes already: {done, number} of {requested, number} done.

codes.count: Create 1 to 50,000 codes at a time.

codes.storeGone.message: The store {name} created its codes in was removed. Create a new pool.

check.unknownTitle.message: There's no discount code pool named {slug}
check.unknownTitle.note: the composer's check; slug: the name in the template, such as welcome15

check.unknownDetail: Readers get no code. Pick a pool in the Discount code block, or create one in Campaigns › Discount codes.

check.archivedTitle.message: The discount code pool {name} is archived

check.archivedDetail: Readers get no code: an archived pool gives none. Pick another pool in the Discount code block.

check.tag.note: the canvas label next to the block a check is about

readiness.label.note: Send Readiness: the row's name in compact tables

readiness.enough.message: Discount codes: {free, number} left in {name} for {recipients, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}
readiness.enough.note: free: codes nobody got yet; name: the pool's name

readiness.notEnough.message: Not enough discount codes: {free, number} left for {recipients, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}

readiness.notEnoughDetail.message: {name} · uploaded codes · one per recipient. Add at least {missing, number} codes, or send to fewer people.

readiness.creating.message: Creating {missing, number} more codes in {store} ({done, number} done). The send starts when they're ready.
readiness.creating.note: store: the store's name; done: codes created so far

readiness.storeShort.message: {name} · {platform} · {free, number} free. Create codes asks {store} for {count, number}, the shortfall and 5% to spare.
readiness.storeShort.note: name: the pool's name; platform: Shopify or WooCommerce; store: the store's name

readiness.creatingBy.message: Started {time} by {who} · the row passes once {store} has confirmed enough codes
readiness.creatingBy.note: time: 10:12; who: a member's name; store: the store's name

readiness.creatingRefill.message: Started {time} by the hourly refill · the row passes once {store} has confirmed enough codes

readiness.archived.message: The discount code pool {name} is archived

readiness.archivedDetail: An archived pool gives no codes. Pick another pool in the email, or remove the Discount code block.

readiness.disconnected.message: {store} isn't connected, so {name} can't create codes or see them used
readiness.disconnected.note: store: the store's name; name: the pool's name

readiness.disconnectedDetail: Reconnect the store, or pick an upload pool in the email.

publish.low.message: {name} has {free, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}} left, under its low mark of {low, number}
publish.low.note: the publish dialog's badge; name: the pool's name

publish.archived.message: {name} is archived: the flow's emails wait for codes, then are skipped

publish.unknown.message: There's no discount code pool named {slug}: readers get no code
publish.unknown.note: slug: the name in the template

notify.lowTitle.message: {name} is running low on discount codes

notify.lowBody.message: {free, plural, one {# code is} other {# codes are}} left, under its low mark of {low, number}. Add or create codes so every reader gets one.

notify.outBody: Campaign messages that show its code aren't sent, and automation emails wait for codes. Add or create codes.

token.code.note: the composer's token menu; name: the pool's name

token.url.note: the address that applies the code
